items.en: Actions are only by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.

Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not harm his neighbor. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest. And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

Two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi (Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him), SubhanAllahil-Azim (Glory be to Allah, the Most Great).
A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe, and an emigrant is the one who leaves what Allah has forbidden.
Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him, through it, a path to Paradise.

Purity is half of faith. Alhamdulillah (praise be to Allah) fills the scale, and SubhanAllah and Alhamdulillah fill what is between the heavens and the earth. Prayer is light, charity is proof, and patience is illumination.

Do not envy one another, do not hate one another, and do not turn your backs on one another. Be, O servants of Allah, brothers. A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not wrong him, abandon him, or look down on him. God-consciousness is here (and he pointed to his chest).
The strong one is not the one who overpowers others in wrestling. The strong one is the one who controls himself when he is angry.
Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
Make things easy and do not make them difficult. Give good news and do not drive people away.
The religion is sincerity.
Charity never decreases wealth. Allah only increases a servant in honor when he forgives, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises him.

How wonderful is the affair of the believer! All of his affairs are good, and this is for no one except the believer. If something good happens to him, he is grateful, and that is good for him. If something harmful befalls him, he is patient, and that is good for him.
Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him.
The closest a servant is to his Lord is when he is in prostration, so make plenty of supplication then.
Whoever says 'SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi' (Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him) one hundred times in a day, his sins will be wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
O Aishah, Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
Whoever guides someone to good will have a reward like the one who does it.

The most beloved words to Allah are four: SubhanAllah (Glory be to Allah), Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), La ilaha illallah (There is no god but Allah), and Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest). It does not matter which of them you begin with.
The example of the believers in their love, mercy, and compassion for one another is like a single body: when one part of it hurts, the rest of the body responds with sleeplessness and fever.
Protect yourselves from the Fire, even if only with half a date.

items.intro: The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Musa:
items.en: Shall I not teach you a phrase that is one of the treasures of Paradise? La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no power and no strength except with Allah).
O people, Allah is good and accepts only what is good.

Every day the sun rises, charity is due on every joint of a person. Bringing justice between two people is charity. Helping a man onto his mount or lifting his luggage onto it is charity. A good word is charity. Every step taken toward prayer is charity, and removing something harmful from the road is charity.
Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
When Allah wants good for someone, He gives him understanding of the religion.
Righteousness is good character, and sin is what troubles your heart and you would dislike people to find out about it.

You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not tell you of something that, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread peace (the greeting of salam) among yourselves.

A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not wrong him or abandon him. Whoever fulfills the need of his brother, Allah will fulfill his need. Whoever relieves a Muslim of a hardship, Allah will relieve him of a hardship on the Day of Resurrection. And whoever covers the faults of a Muslim, Allah will cover his faults on the Day of Resurrection.
Allah has prescribed excellence in everything.

items.intro: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ for advice. He said:
items.en: Do not become angry. (The man repeated his request several times, and each time he said: Do not become angry.)

The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and there is good in both. Be keen on what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not give up. If something befalls you, do not say, 'If only I had done such and such,' but say, 'Allah has decreed, and He does what He wills,' for 'if only' opens the door to the work of Satan.
Every act of kindness is charity.

items.intro: The Prophet ﷺ was asked which deeds are most beloved to Allah. He said:
items.en: The most consistent of them, even if they are small.
Richness is not having many possessions. True richness is the richness of the soul.
When one of you looks at someone who has been given more wealth or a better appearance, let him look at someone who has been given less.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler passing through.

Whoever seeks to be chaste, Allah will make him chaste. Whoever seeks to be self-sufficient, Allah will make him self-sufficient. Whoever strives to be patient, Allah will give him patience. And no one has been given a gift better or more vast than patience.
Allah loves the servant who is God-conscious, content, and does not seek to be seen.
A person will be with those whom he loves.

The rights of a Muslim upon another Muslim are five: returning the greeting of peace, visiting the sick, following the funeral procession, accepting an invitation, and saying 'May Allah have mercy on you' when he sneezes.

Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech. Do not spy on one another, do not pry into one another's affairs, do not envy one another, do not turn your backs on one another, and do not hate one another. Be, O servants of Allah, brothers.
Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and hoping for reward, his past sins will be forgiven.
The five daily prayers, and one Friday prayer to the next, are an expiation for what is between them, as long as major sins are avoided.

If there were a river at the door of one of you in which he bathed five times every day, would any dirt remain on him? (They said: No dirt would remain.) He said: That is the example of the five prayers; through them Allah wipes away sins.
No Muslim plants a tree or sows a crop, and then a bird, a person, or an animal eats from it, except that it is counted as charity for him.

Allah the Exalted says: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me within himself, I remember him within Myself. If he remembers Me in a gathering, I remember him in a gathering better than it. If he draws near to Me a hand's span, I draw near to him an arm's length. And if he comes to Me walking, I come to him running.
When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, knowledge that benefits others, or a righteous child who prays for him.

Allah is more delighted with the repentance of His servant when he turns to Him than one of you who was on his camel in a barren desert, and it ran away from him carrying his food and drink. He lost all hope of finding it, lay down in the shade of a tree, and then suddenly found it standing beside him.

Our Lord, Blessed and Exalted, descends every night to the lowest heaven when the last third of the night remains, and says: Who is calling upon Me, that I may answer him? Who is asking of Me, that I may give him? Who is seeking My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?

items.narrator: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah
items.en: No fatigue, illness, worry, grief, harm, or distress befalls a Muslim, not even a thorn that pricks him, except that Allah wipes away some of his sins because of it.

Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. A person keeps telling the truth until he becomes a truthful one. Lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire.
Gentleness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it, and it is not removed from anything except that it disfigures it.
Jibril kept urging me to treat the neighbor well until I thought he would make him an heir.
The one who works to support the widow and the poor is like one who strives in the path of Allah, or like one who prays all night and fasts every day.
I and the one who cares for an orphan will be in Paradise like this (and he held up his index and middle fingers, slightly apart).
Whoever would like his provision to be increased and his life to be extended, let him keep good ties with his relatives.
Whoever cheats us is not one of us.
Allah is beautiful and loves beauty. Arrogance is rejecting the truth and looking down on people.

When Allah loves a servant, He calls Jibril: 'Allah loves so-and-so, so love him.' Jibril loves him, then calls out to the people of heaven: 'Allah loves so-and-so, so love him.' The people of heaven love him, and then acceptance is placed for him on earth.
Convey from me, even if it is one verse.
The most beloved of you to me are those with the best character.
The best of you are those with the best character.
Allah has pardoned my community for the thoughts that cross their minds, as long as they do not act on them or speak of them.

Whoever intends a good deed but does not do it, Allah records it with Him as one complete good deed. If he intends it and does it, Allah records it with Him as ten good deeds, up to seven hundred times, or many more. Whoever intends a bad deed but does not do it, Allah records it with Him as one complete good deed. And if he intends it and does it, Allah records it as only one bad deed.
A believer is not stung from the same hole twice.

The example of a good companion and a bad companion is like one who carries musk and one who works a blacksmith's bellows. The one carrying musk may give you some, or you may buy some from him, or at least you will enjoy a pleasant scent from him. The one working the bellows may burn your clothes, or at least you will smell a foul odor from him.
There are two blessings that many people lose out on: health and free time.
